args.title: Announce error toasts assertively and keep them until dismissed
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Error toasts currently share the single `role="status" aria-live="polite"` region used for all toast kinds, and every toast (success, info, error alike) auto-dismisses after AUTO_DISMISS_MS (5s) via the shared Toast component's timer.

Change: give error toasts an assertive live region (e.g. render a second container with `role="alert" aria-live="assertive"` for items of kind "error", or switch the live region's politeness per item), and skip the auto-dismiss timer for error-kind toasts so they stay visible until the user dismisses them via the close button.

file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

In Toast.tsx, all toasts share one `role="status" aria-live="polite"` container, and the per-toast `useEffect` timer auto-dismisses every item after AUTO_DISMISS_MS (5000ms) regardless of kind. Error toasts need an assertive live region (`aria-live="assertive"`/`role="alert"`) and should skip the auto-dismiss timer, staying until the user closes them.
